name: Campingplatz Hager
beschreibung: The Hager campsite is located in the municipality of Langkampfen in the Tiroler Unterinntal, near the town of Kufstein and the German border. The surroundings are shaped by the mountain ranges of the Wilder Kaiser and the Inntal. In summer, the surrounding trails can be used for hiking and mountain bike tours. In winter, guests can reach the ski areas of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and the Alpbachtal area within a short drive. The campsite's facilities include pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as sanitary facilities. An on-site restaurant and a shop for basic supplies are available on the grounds. The campsite is geared toward family-friendly guests and is located in quiet surroundings that allow for a stay close to nature.
